description: Establish ultra-premium design system with glassmorphism, advanced gradients, depth, and animation tokens. Create design system foundation that will be used by all subsequent page redesigns. Enhance index.css with premium color palettes (emerald gradients, glass backgrounds), typography scale, spacing system, shadow depths, and animation curves. Add new UI primitives: Badge, Tooltip, Skeleton loaders, Toast enhancements, GlassCard variant.
steps: 1. Enhance src/index.css @theme block: add premium gradient color stops (--color-gradient-start, --color-gradient-end for each brand color 500-700), glass effect variables (--glass-bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.7), --glass-border: rgba(255,255,255,0.2)), shadow depth scale (--shadow-sm through --shadow-2xl with colored shadows like 0 10px 40px rgba(16,185,129,0.15)), animation timing functions (--ease-smooth, --ease-bounce), extended spacing scale for premium layouts

2. Create src/components/ui/Badge.jsx: small pill component with variants (default, success, warning, error, info, premium with gradient), sizes (sm, md, lg), icon support, dot indicator option, example: <Badge variant='premium' icon={<Star />}>Pro</Badge>

3. Create src/components/ui/Tooltip.jsx: accessible tooltip with Framer Motion animations, positions (top, bottom, left, right), delay prop, dark/light themes, follows cursor on hover, example: <Tooltip content='Delete item'><IconButton>...</IconButton></Tooltip>

4. Create src/components/ui/Skeleton.jsx: loading skeleton with variants (text, avatar, card, button), animated shimmer effect using CSS gradients, width/height props, example: <Skeleton variant='card' className='h-48' />

5. Enhance src/components/ui/Card.jsx: add new 'glass' variant with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl, semi-transparent bg, subtle border), 'premium' variant with gradient border and shadow-lg, depth prop (1-5 for shadow intensity), hover lift animations for interactive cards

6. Create src/components/ui/Toast.jsx (custom wrapper for react-hot-toast): configure default toast styles with glassmorphism, success/error/info variants with icons, position bottom-center, duration 4000ms, custom animations (slide + fade)
7. Update src/components/ui/index.js: add exports for Badge, Tooltip, Skeleton, and document usage examples in JSDoc comments
acceptance_criteria: index.css contains extended @theme with gradient variables, glass variables, shadow scale, animation curves
Badge component created with 6+ variants, icon support, and proper TypeScript-style JSDoc
Tooltip component created with accessibility (role='tooltip', aria-describedby) and motion animations
Skeleton component created with shimmer animation and 4+ variants
Card component has 'glass' and 'premium' variants plus depth prop
Toast configuration applied with premium styling
All new components exported from src/components/ui/index.js
verification: Run 'npm run dev' and create a temporary test page at src/pages/DesignSystemTest.jsx showcasing all new components
Add route to App.jsx: <Route path='/test-design' element={<DesignSystemTest />} />
Navigate to /test-design - verify Badge renders in all variants with correct colors
Verify Tooltip appears on hover with smooth animation
Verify Skeleton shimmer animation is visible
Verify Card glass variant has backdrop-blur and transparency
Verify Card premium variant has gradient border
Trigger a toast with toast.success('Test') - verify glassmorphism styling applied
Remove test page and route after verification
